subject: Atlas Health — Demo recording & slides + quick Q&A?
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
To: Sam Torres <sam.torres@atlashealth.com>, Nate Li <nate.li@atlashealth.com>
Cc: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 18 Feb 2026 17:12:00 +0000
Subject: Atlas Health — Demo recording & slides + quick Q&A?

Hi Sam & Nate,

Thanks again for taking the time to meet today — really enjoyed learning more about Atlas Health's ingestion pipeline and the privacy requirements you mentioned. Per our conversation, attached is the recording from the demo and the slide deck with the architecture notes and cost/latency benchmarks.

Quick recap and next steps:
- We demoed a POC using a 4-shard Redwood Dedicated configuration with prefix caching for common patient templates.
- Estimated starting footprint: 2 dedicated GPUs for ~200 qps during peak; we showed options to scale to 4 if latency requirements tighten.
- Security: Private deployment with KMS integration and audit logs was discussed — Vivek will follow up with the SOC2 artifact if that remains helpful.

If helpful, I can block a short 20-minute Q&A to go through any questions on the recording / slides or to walk through the SOC2 evidence. Do any of these slots work next week?
- Tue 3/2 10:00–10:30 PT
- Wed 3/3 14:00–14:30 PT
- Thu 3/4 09:00–09:30 PT

Attachments: atlas-demo-recording.mp4, redwood-demo-slides.pdf

Thanks —
Marissa Cole
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
marissa@redwood.com | (415) 555-0198

--
Redwood Inference | Developer-first inference.
